C0590.title: Beijing Ximei Medical Aesthetics Clinic Price Fraud Case
C0590.summary: In July 2022, the Beijing Municipal Market Supervision Administration investigated Beijing Ximei Medical Aesthetics Clinic for displaying a discounted price of '¥17,940, saved ¥8,060' for 'Juvederm Ultra Plus' hyaluronic acid injections on its Dianping store without indicating the calculation basis for the discount, constituting price fraud. The clinic was fined 60,000 yuan.
